test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts and decide which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given statements.

Statements:

All bats are balls.

All balls are wickets.

No wickets are gloves.

Conclusions:

(I) Some balls are bats.

(II) Some wickets are balls.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76bea992f80e05c35eb1a6f083c6760262f865bff49b6a842187942a9b08e488.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some balls are bats → True (because all bats are balls, so some balls are also bats)

II. Some wickets are balls → True (because all balls are wickets, so some wickets are also balls)

∴ Here, Both conclusions (I) and (II) follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
